text: Account credit is the family's money. They should see it used, not forgotten.
This is the household balance. Credit counts against what they owe.
Credit pays at checkout, including credit from eVet.
To add credit by hand, click Add credit.
This adds money to the family's account.
Type the amount.
And why. It's saved with your name on the account ledger.
Then click Add credit.
The credit shows on the ledger as a negative line.
A pay link now asks only for what's left after the credit.
Add more, and the line updates right away. Click Add credit again.
Type a bigger amount.
With a reason.
And add it.
When the credit covers the whole bill, Scout tells you to use Account credit instead of sending a pay link.
At checkout, click Account credit.
Scout shows what's available.
Click Apply credit.
And it shows what's left.
Credit also comes from returns, overpayments and eVet. Credit from eVet can only be spent once eVet sync is turned off.

The most common mistakes are charging the card when the family has credit, and adding credit without a clear reason. Remember: credit pays at checkout, including credit from eVet, but only once eVet sync is off.
